en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 32.ʿUthmān ibn ʿĪsā narrated from Samāʿah, from Abū Baṣīr, from alNaḍr ibn ʿĀṣim, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (a) who said regarding the verse:
…who give whatever they give with their hearts fearful… (Q23:60), “They perform [good] deeds and know that they will be rewarded for it.”
